findings.evidence: Z12 is the only non-formula month in the 24-period Overhead row. The immediately preceding periods roll forward overhead as ROUND(prior-month overhead*(1+monthly overhead inflation),0); applying that established pattern to Y12 (25,176) and the 0.72% rate gives 25,357, rather than the hardcoded 21,192.2. The hardcode lowers the final-month overhead by 4,164.8, overstating total EBITDA (P&L!AA15) by that amount. It also increases the trailing-12-month EBITDA used in Valuation!B5; at the 6.8x multiple, Enterprise Value (Valuation!B7) is overstated by 28,321 after rounding.
